elevationHeight.$description: Native-only (ADR 0016). Android elevation in dp for each elevation.* role — Compose Surface(shadowElevation = …), React Native Android `elevation`. Android's own light model, not a copy of the web box-shadow, so it cannot be derived from it. iOS (SwiftUI, RN iOS) derives its shadow from the shared elevation.* token instead. PROVISIONAL until Phase 5 visual validation on real native components.
